in_marathi.name: Mahananda
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahananda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maha (Great) + Ananda (Joy). This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a tribute to the profound feeling of happiness and satisfaction that comes from within. It is a name that signifies a joyous and blissful life.
